audit.why: TRICKY at 7.5/10 with a 54.55% win rate over 2860 games is consistent — Sion wins lane on average but the matchup demands cage discipline, and the side lane belongs to Yorick afterwards.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three rows disagreed with the page. Level 2 was Skill though whys[1] says a brushline knockup 'wins the trade cleanly'. Level 6 was Yorick though whys[4] says 'neither side owns this stage cleanly'. Worst, 2+ items was scored to SION while whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say never 1v1 him in a corridor and that the Maiden runs the side lane without him.
audit.why: Telling a Sion he owns the two-item stage against a Maiden split is how a player loses a won game. The packet chart reads Skill/Sion/Sion/Sion/Skill/Sion/Yorick.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 4 and 6 corrected in both layers with matching ratings. Row 0 left alone: the packet says Skill but whys[0] describes a genuine Yorick poke edge, and I would rather leave one arguable row than invent a swing.
sources: existing whys[1], whys[4], whys[6], spikes[3], late

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0] claimed Dark Procession 'cancels your pattern' when cast mid-Q-charge. Dark Procession is a destructible wall that blocks movement — Riot's text gives it no interrupt, no damage and no CC. It does not cancel a Sion Q channel. Separately, the ability was described as having 'a long cooldown at level 3' without ever naming the number: it is 20/18/16/14/12.
audit.why: The real danger of the cage is being walled INSIDE the ghoul pile after the knockup, not losing the channel — and the whole trade pattern is built on counting a cooldown the page never printed.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[0] rewritten around being walled in; the 20s rank-1 timer written into whys[2] and spikes[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds anywhere, despite Last Rites healing Yorick on a 6s cooldown at rank 1, and no mention that Last Rites is an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: His sustain is what makes the extended trade survivable for him, and the reset wind-up is the earliest tell that a trade has started.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal written into the first-item spike; the reset tell into whys[0].

edits.before: Yorick's level 1 is E-poke from range — last-hit at Q tip and give nothing back; your W-shield absorbs his mist-walker hit if he steps up.
edits.after: Mourning Mist marks you from 700 range and speeds his Walkers onto the mark — last-hit at Q tip, and watch the Last Rites wind-up, not the cast.

edits.before: Full kit online and Dark Procession still has a long cooldown at level 3 — run E-slow into charged Q and W-shield the counter-hit, winning the sustained trade.
edits.after: Full kit online and Dark Procession is 20 seconds at rank 1 — run E-slow into charged Q, W-shield the counter-hit, and be out before the cage is back up.

edits.before: Heartsteel's HP compound makes your W-shield enormous and your passive zombie genuinely threatening — force the all-in on Dark Procession's cooldown the moment it completes.
edits.after: Heartsteel makes your W-shield enormous, but Last Rites heals him on a 6s reset — pair the first item with Grievous Wounds and all-in while the 20s cage is spent.

edits.before: Land Dark Procession on you mid-Q-charge to cancel your pattern and let ghouls stack inside the cage
edits.after: Wall you in with Dark Procession after the knockup so you cannot leave the ghoul pile while it beats on you

notes: Both packet suspectNames are FALSE POSITIVES — 'Dark Procession' is the correct name for Yorick's W in both flagged strings. KIT FLAG MISFIRE: Yorick's E carries a 'dash' flag, but Riot's description says he throws a globule of Black Mist; there is no dash in the text and I wrote nothing based on that flag. Sion Q's listed range of 10000 is a data artifact and was not used.
